title: finding(platform-readings): objectui's labeler runs with `sync-labels: true`, so a hand-applied PR label is silently removed on the next push — and the four-step read-back happens inside the window where it still looks fine
body:
objectui's `Auto Label PRs` workflow runs `actions/labeler@v7` with **`sync-labels: true`**, so a pull request's labels are a **path-derived set the workflow rewrites wholesale** on every `opened` / `synchronize` event. ⇒ **a hand-applied PR label outside that derived set is silently removed on the next push.**

This is a platform fact, ⛔ not a defect report: it belongs in the fact table a seat consults at the moment it writes a PR label, because the four-step label protocol's read-back 「回读 diff 对 union(现集, 增删)」 will read back **clean** and the label will still vanish minutes later when the next commit lands.

## Measured at source

```
objectstack-ai/objectui  .github/workflows/labeler.yml
 :73      - uses: actions/labeler@v7
 :77          sync-labels: true
```

Seat-verified on objectui `origin/main` `1ed2e69facc62018ff19f30197ac7add1d599c39` in this act.

## ⭐ Why the existing protocol does not catch it

The label-write protocol's fourth step is a **read-back immediately after the write**. Against a workflow that rewrites on the **next push**, that read-back is taken inside the window where the hand-applied label is still present. ⇒ the protocol reports success, and the loss happens later with no second reading.

⇒ the existing guidance 「union 有而回读缺 = 被并发剥掉,重挂并报告」 is the right instinct pointed at the wrong moment: on a PR in this repo the stripper is **scheduled**, ⛔ not concurrent, so re-applying would simply lose the race again on the following push.

## What a seat should do instead

- ⛔ Do not hand-apply PR labels in objectui expecting them to survive — derive-or-accept: if the label is not what `.github/labeler.yml` produces for the diff's paths, it is not a durable carrier.
- ⚠️ Anything that must be **durable on a PR** belongs in the PR **body** or a **comment**, ⛔ not a label.
- ⭐ Gate-semantic labels on PRs (the `needs:contract-review` family) are the case that matters most: the charter treats a stripped gate label as 「放行」 rather than a red light, and a **workflow** doing the stripping is not the concurrent seat that rule was written about.

⚠️ ⛔ **NOT MEASURED by this filing**: whether `needs:contract-review` is inside or outside the set `.github/labeler.yml` derives, and therefore whether that specific gate is exposed. That is one read of the config against one governed PR's paths, and this card does ⛔ not make the claim — it names the question. ⛔ Also not measured: whether objectstack's own labeler carries the same setting.

## Provenance

Surfaced by the objectui#9925 dev while explaining why its additive label write and the workflow agreed: the three labels it saw (`plugin`, `plugin: kanban`, `tests`) are exactly what the config derives from that diff. ⭐ It read the agreement, then read **why** they agreed — which is how the setting surfaced at all.

## Dedupe words

`actions/labeler sync-labels true` · `PR label rewritten wholesale` · `hand-applied label silently removed` · `labeler.yml path-derived label set` · `label read-back inside the window`
